en: Who's there? Oh! You're a trainer! Please help me, a scary Pokémon keeps following me!
A Hypno stepped out from behind the trees!
It's gone... Thank you! I came to pick berries, and then I got lost, and then that Pokémon came.
Here, this is the best berry I found today. You can have it.
Will you take me home? Daddy will be so worried.
